name: Bulk QR codes from a link list (Bulk QR Generator API)

parameters.content:
## Bulk QR Code Generator — link list → QR code PNGs

This workflow calls the free public QR code API from **[Bulk QR Generator](https://bulkqrgenerator.net/)** and turns a list of links into ready-to-print QR code PNG images — one file per link, in seconds.

**API:** `GET https://bulkqrgenerator.net/api/v1/qr?text=...&format=png&size=512`
- Free, no sign-up, no API key required
- SVG or PNG output, custom colors, sizes up to 2048px
- Generate in bulk from your browser: https://bulkqrgenerator.net/

### How to use
1. Edit the **Sample Links** node — one `name` + `url` per QR code.
2. Click **Execute workflow**.
3. Each link is encoded by `https://bulkqrgenerator.net/api/v1/qr` and saved as `qr-<name>.png`.

### Notes
- On n8n Cloud, replace **Save QR PNG** with Google Drive / Dropbox / Email — the QR image arrives as binary data, ready to attach or upload.
- Encode anything a QR code can hold: URLs, WiFi credentials (`WIFI:T:WPA;S:Name;P:password;;`), phone numbers (`tel:+15551234567`), plain text.
- Fair use: the API is rate-limited to 1 request/second per IP — the batch loop here stays well under it.

Made with the free bulk QR code generator: https://bulkqrgenerator.net/
